description: This file defines a class called Keyboard that manages the virtual keyboard view in an Android application. It includes methods for initializing, inflating, resetting, and handling key presses on a QWERTY keyboard layout, including state toggling for shift and symbol modes.

classes.name: Keyboard
classes.description: Controller for the virtual keyboard view, handling initialization, key mapping, state management (shift/symbol), and user interaction.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for special keys like shift, delete, symbol, space, and enter, based on their data code.

methods.name: qwerty
methods.description: Factory method that creates and configures a qwerty keyboard layout with predefined key mappings.

methods.name: inflateKeyboardView
methods.description: Inflates the keyboard layout into a View object and maps keys.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the keyboard state to default and updates the key labels.

methods.name: mapKeys
methods.description: Assigns labels and click handlers to each key based on current state.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles key press actions including toggling shift and symbol states, or delegating input to AutofillImeService.
